items.content:
America’s demographic tailwind is fading.

Growth in the 25-64 population:
1980s: 1.8% per year
1990s: 1.1% per year
Next decade: 0.3% per year

And that assumes immigration rebounds.

Future economic growth will increasingly depend on productivity gains.
— Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello) Sep 13, 2026

items.title: Good morning. Have to disagree with Mohamed here. This is the most straightfoward FOMC meeting in years. The Fed has woefully failed on their mandate of delivering price stability and are far behind the curve. 66 consecutive months is long enough. The rate hikes are coming.
items.content:
Good morning.

Have to disagree with Mohamed here.

This is the most straightfoward FOMC meeting in years.

The Fed has woefully failed on their mandate of delivering price stability and are far behind the curve.

66 consecutive months is long enough.

The rate hikes are coming.Mohamed A. El-Erian (@elerianm)Good morning.
This week’s Federal Reserve policy meeting may well be the trickiest in years.
Ironically, it’s less about what’s happening in the economy and more about a sudden shift in rate-hike expectations, driven by thre surge in yields ... that has less to do with the Fed and more to do with the growing ex-ante imbalance between demand for bond financing and its supply.
 #economy   #markets   #federalreserve —  https://x.com/elerianm/status/2099121564469936556 
— Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello) Sep 13, 2026
